identificationModule.officialTitle: CARs for CNS-Leukemia Relapse: A Retrospective International Study

primaryOutcomes.description: Duration between CAR T-cell infusion and death or last follow-up, according to Kaplan-Meier analysis

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Incidence of CAR-related CRS or ICANS per ASCTC guidelines
secondaryOutcomes.description: Number of patients and average grade of cytokine-release syndrome and immune-effector cell associated neurotoxicity syndrome within 2 months after CAR treatment, according to ASCTC guidelines (Lee et al, BBMT 2019)
Duration between CAR T-cell infusion and leukemia relapse, according to Kaplan-Meier analysis
Duration between CAR T-cell infusion and CNS leukemia relapse, according to Kaplan-Meier analysis

eligibilityModule.eligibilityCriteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Prior diagnosis of B-cell acute lymphoblastic leukemia involving the central nervous system
* Treatment with CAR T cells (either on a clinical trial or commercial use) due to this indication
eligibilityModule.studyPopulation: Retrospective review of patients with CNS - involvement of B-cell ALL, treated with CAR T cells targeting CD19 of either an institutional-based clinical trial, a pharma-based clinical trial or commercial product.
